Summary Description: Kara B. De León is a microbiologist specializing in wastewater-based epidemiology, environmental microbiology, and microbial genomics. Her research encompasses evaluating the specificity of Enterolert for Enterococcus in freshwater contexts, comprehensive wastewater surveillance for gastrointestinal pathogens and SARS-CoV-2 variants, and the synthesis of community-oriented analyses on bacterial WBE. She also contributes to large-scale functional genomics in Desulfovibrio vulgaris Hildenborough using RB-TnSeq to map essential genes and phenotypes across diverse conditions, highlighting the integration of experimental microbiology with data science and open resources to advance environmental health surveillance, AMR detection, and microbial physiology.
